bio:
JEVO is a DJ and producer based in his peculiar take on club music incorporates Latin rhythms as well as dark industrial sounds for a modern dancefloor experience.

 In the previous works, he has been featured on several renowned radios such as Internet Public Radio,deadHYPE, Paynomindtous and Wide Radio, where he presented dynamic mixtures of multiple genres and BPMs, with tracks by producers from all over the world and many of his own blends and edits.

 The name chosen for his residency will be "Visión Bellaka," where he will continue exploring the fusion of Latin rhythms with everything possible.
title: JEVO
